The use of anabolic steroids is more consistent with B4 (Traumatic or Compressive Disorder), as it can increase the risk of muscle and tendon injuries, whereas B1 (Neoplastic Disorder), B2 (Inflammatory or Autoimmune Disorder), and B3 (Vascular Disorder) are less directly related to anabolic steroid use.
